provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: direct construction: the single-copy state as a combination of two stabilizer states

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; direct construction, no search

notes: The single-copy cell. |H3> is not a stabilizer state (its nonzero amplitudes have two different moduli, the lower-bound certificate of the same cell), and it lies in the span of two stabilizer states; this is the first of the 5 rank-2 decompositions listed in research/constructions/data/H3_m1_rank2.json, with coefficients fitted exactly. The implied exponent log_p(2) is the trivial one and moves nothing; the cell is filed so the orbit page shows chi = 2 at m = 1 as it does for S, T3, and T5.
